$schema_comment: Runtime feeds mirrored into dist/ear/feeds/ and served by the EAR. See README 'Feeds'. Types: 'file' downloads a URL verbatim; 'taxii' pulls a TAXII 2.x collection (all pages) and flattens it to {"objects": [...]} for the ti_custom integration's CEL input. Auth is optional per feed; any referenced env var that is unset causes the feed to be skipped, not failed. Set 'enabled': false to skip a feed entirely. 'dest' is relative to dist/ear/feeds/ (taxii feeds default to taxii/<name>.json).

feeds.name: cisa-kev
feeds.description: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog; the cisa_kevs integration's `url` var is repointed at this file

feeds.name: limo-urlhaus
feeds.description: abuse.ch URLhaus malware URLs via Anomali Limo (free TAXII 2.x, guest/guest) — enable if limo.anomali.com is reachable

feeds.name: limo-threatfox
feeds.description: abuse.ch ThreatFox IOCs via Anomali Limo (free TAXII 2.x, guest/guest) — enable if limo.anomali.com is reachable

feeds.name: mitre-attack-enterprise
feeds.description: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise — TTPs/tools rather than IoCs; enable to smoke-test the TAXII path

feeds.name: cvelistv5
feeds.description: CVE Project CVE List V5 — nightly baseline zip of all CVE JSON 5.0 records (~700 MB, dated filename; same-day re-runs skip). Index into ES for offline CVE lookup or enrich vulnerability findings.

feeds.name: opencti
feeds.description: OpenCTI TAXII 2.1 collection — url is the '/taxii2/root' API root of your instance; collection is its title or UUID (Data > Data sharing > TAXII Collections). OPENCTI_TOKEN is a profile API key. Skipped while the env var is unset.

feeds.name: example-keyed-feed
feeds.description: Template for a key-gated feed: export the env var before `task download:feeds`; skipped while unset
